item.name: T-API-AUTH-002: Account locks after 5 consecutive failed logins

exec: // TODO: replace with real assertions - status code, schema and data (brief section 8.2)
pm.test("T-API-AUTH-002: status code is as expected", function () {

request.description:
Steps:
1. POST 4 wrong passwords for a disposable user (expect 401 with a generic error)
2. POST the 5th wrong password
3. POST the correct password

Expected: Failures 1-5 return 401 with a generic error; the correct password after the 5th failure is refused with a locked status (e.g. 423/403) and a lockout message; a different user is unaffected

item.name: T-API-AUTH-003: Logout invalidates the session token

request.description:
Steps:
1. Log in and capture the token

Expected: Logout returns 200/204; the same token is then rejected with 401

item.name: T-API-AUTH-004: Password reset link issues a single-use token and updates the password

exec: // TODO: replace with real assertions - status code, schema and data (brief section 8.2)
pm.test("T-API-AUTH-004: status code is as expected", function () {

request.description:
Steps:
1. POST forgot-password for a known email
2. Retrieve the reset token from the test mailbox
3. POST reset-password with a new password
4. Log in with the new password
5. Re-use the reset token

Expected: A reset email/token is issued; the password is changed; the new password works and the old one fails; re-using the token is rejected; unknown emails get a generic response
